reason: Create the empty history tables of the calls schema (transcript_entry with its unique index, the transcript_fts search index and transcript_staged), then move recorded transcripts to the numbered speakers of their listening: one full read of transcript_line utterances numbers each (track, segment, provider speaker) pair of the other side into listening_speaker, and one full UPDATE of the utterance bodies replaces the provider speaker with that number and drops the speaker of each unit. Measured during authoring on one development machine: transcript_line 1821 rows (max rowid 1821) over 22 listenings, 1781 of them utterances.
